questions.text: What does liquid staking give you in exchange for your staked assets?
options: Immediate withdrawal of your staked tokens with no lock-up period
A derivative token usable in other DeFi applications while the original tokens stay locked
A requirement to run your own validator node
questions.explanation: Liquid staking protocols issue a derivative token representing your deposit, usable elsewhere while the underlying stays locked.

questions.text: True or false: if you delegate your tokens to a validator and they act dishonestly, your delegated tokens are not exposed to slashing risk.
questions.explanation: Delegated tokens can still face slashing if the validator misbehaves.
